description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
If Kiora's Follower has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
If Clever Conjurer has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hawkeye's Bow
uses.cardState: attached to either Kiora's Follower or Clever Conjurer
